teaching.title: Peer Programming Mentor
bullets: Supported beginner practice sessions focused on lists, arrays, and loops as a peer programming mentor.
Explained worked examples involving lists, arrays, and loops under a course instructor's supervision.

projects.title: Course Planner
bullets: Contributed to a team course planner project by implementing a menu-driven Python program using functions and collections.
Added input checks, handled invalid entries, and tested representative inputs while recording their expected outputs.

projects.title: Book Lending Records
bullets: Designed related tables and key constraints for book lending records using SQL and SQLite.
Documented the book lending schema and example queries as part of the individual course project.

projects.title: Task Queue
bullets: Implemented linked structures and traversal operations in Python for a team task queue project using Git.
Compared alternative data structures for the recorded operations and wrote tests for insertion, lookup, and deletion.
